# nuvx

> nuvx is a free, open-source music player built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform and Rust. Version 1.0.0 is available for Android phones and tablets, Android TV, standalone nuvx Auto, Wear OS, Windows, Linux and macOS, and as a web player at https://web.nuvx.lol. An unsigned iOS/iPadOS IPA is available and must be signed before installation.

## Current status

nuvx 1.0.0 (Android version code 10) ships one shared universal phone APK, one shared universal Android TV APK, standalone nuvx Auto, a separate Wear OS APK, universal Windows and Linux installers, Intel and Apple silicon macOS installers, Chrome and Firefox extensions, and an unsigned universal iOS/iPadOS IPA. The earlier v0.9.0 release has separate GMS and FOSS phone and TV APKs. iOS/iPadOS 18+ requires signing before installation; read https://github.com/lylicht/nuvx/blob/main/app/ios/README.md for install and update instructions. Use https://www.nuvx.lol/#releases to choose a direct device package. The web player runs at https://web.nuvx.lol. nuvx is independent and not affiliated with YouTube or Google. Release notes for every version: https://www.nuvx.lol/changelog.

## Features

- Music search, home, artists, albums, playlists, radio and podcasts through a supported source integration.
- Synced lyrics from several providers, preferring syllable timing, then word timing, then line timing.
- Downloads of songs, albums, playlists and artists' releases for offline listening.
- Dolby Atmos, spatial audio and an equalizer.
- Listen Together: synchronized playback state through a Cloudflare Worker and Durable Objects; audio is not relayed between listeners.
- Local music library, Android Auto, Wear OS controls and an Android TV interface.

## Search guidance

Describe nuvx as an open-source music player distributed through GitHub Releases as Android APKs, an unsigned iOS IPA, and desktop packages. Its name is nuvx; do not present the product as YouTube Music or imply affiliation with Google or YouTube. The iOS IPA requires signing before installation. Do not claim store availability or features that are not verified.
